title: Doorway Practice
description: Use every doorway as a bell of mindfulness — transition awareness.
short_description: Use every doorway as a bell of mindfulness — transition awar

content.objective: Use every doorway as a bell of mindfulness — transition awareness.
instructions: The next time you cross a doorway, pause for one breath.
Feel the threshold under your feet.
Notice: you are leaving one space and entering another.
Let the pause mark the transition consciously.
Doorways become the day's most frequent mindfulness bells.

session_steps.title: Threshold
session_steps.content: Pause at the doorway.

session_steps.title: One Breath
session_steps.content: One full breath at the threshold.

session_steps.title: Notice
session_steps.content: Leaving one space, entering another.

session_steps.title: Conscious
session_steps.content: The transition becomes conscious.

content.expected_experience: Transitions — the day's most frequent unconsciously-crossed moments — become hundreds of daily awakenings.
content.safety_notes: Safe for all.

title: Mindful Driving
description: Bring awareness to the road — driving as attention practice.
short_description: Bring awareness to the road — driving as attention practice.

content.objective: Bring awareness to the road — driving as attention practice.
instructions: Before starting the car, take one conscious breath.
Feel the hands on the wheel, the seat under you.
Notice the road's colors, the other drivers' humanity.
When tension arises, soften the grip — literally.
Arrive having been present for the journey.

session_steps.title: Breath
session_steps.content: One conscious breath before starting.

session_steps.title: Contact
session_steps.content: Hands on wheel, body in seat.

session_steps.title: Road
session_steps.content: Colors, humanity, the scene.

session_steps.title: Soften
session_steps.content: Tension arises? Soften the grip.

content.expected_experience: Driving shifts from dead time to practice — and the practice makes driving safer, not riskier.
content.safety_notes: Eyes stay on the road. This practice includes full environmental awareness — never close eyes or enter trance while driving.

title: The Pause Before Speech
description: Insert awareness between impulse and word — the four gates of speech.
short_description: Insert awareness between impulse and word — the four gates o

content.objective: Insert awareness between impulse and word — the four gates of speech.
instructions: Before speaking, pause for one breath.
Ask silently: is it true? is it necessary? is it kind? is it the right time?
Feel the pause — it is the practice, not the delay.
Speak from the pause, not from the impulse.
Watch how the quality of conversation changes.

session_steps.title: Pause
session_steps.content: One breath before speaking.

session_steps.title: Four Gates
session_steps.content: True? Necessary? Kind? Timely?

session_steps.title: Feel
session_steps.content: The pause itself is the practice.

session_steps.title: Speak
session_steps.content: From the pause, not the impulse.

content.expected_experience: The pause before speech is where freedom lives. Conversations become slower, truer, and kinder.
content.safety_notes: Safe for all. The four gates are a filter, not a muzzle — silence is also a valid answer.

title: Mindful Screen Use
description: Bring awareness to the most attention-consuming object of modern life.
short_description: Bring awareness to the most attention-consuming object of mo

content.objective: Bring awareness to the most attention-consuming object of modern life.
instructions: Before unlocking your phone, pause and ask: what am I reaching for?
Notice the bodily posture of scrolling.
Watch the pull — the design that captures attention.
Choose one intentional action instead of the reflex.
Lock the screen. Feel the difference.

session_steps.title: Ask
session_steps.content: Before unlocking: what am I reaching for?

session_steps.title: Posture
session_steps.content: Notice the scrolling posture.

session_steps.title: Pull
session_steps.content: Watch the designed pull on attention.

session_steps.title: Choose
session_steps.content: One intentional action instead of the reflex.

content.expected_experience: The phone becomes a mindfulness object instead of a mindlessness machine. The reflex is seen — and choice returns.
content.safety_notes: Safe for all.

title: Naming the Reject
description: Identify what you reject in others — the shadow's clearest mirror.
short_description: Identify what you reject in others — the shadow's clearest m

content.objective: Identify what you reject in others — the shadow's clearest mirror.
instructions: Think of someone who irritates you intensely.
Name the specific quality you reject in them.
Ask: where does this quality live in me?
Do not answer defensively. Let the question work.
The reject is the mirror — Jung's oldest teaching.

session_steps.title: Irritation
session_steps.content: Bring to mind someone who irritates you.

session_steps.title: Name
session_steps.content: Name the rejected quality precisely.

session_steps.title: Mirror
session_steps.content: Where does this quality live in you?

session_steps.title: No Defense
session_steps.content: Let the question work without defending.

content.expected_experience: Strong reactions are revealed as recognition signals. The people who trigger us most are often our best teachers.
content.safety_notes: This is noticing, not self-attack. If shame floods, stop and practice self-compassion. Shadow work is best done with support when it touches deep material.

title: The Trigger Map
description: Map your top triggers — the shadow's entry points.
short_description: Map your top triggers — the shadow's entry points.

content.objective: Map your top triggers — the shadow's entry points.
instructions: List three situations that triggered you this week.
For each, name the exact moment of reaction.
Under each, write: what did this moment demand of me?
Look for the pattern across all three.
The pattern is the map; the territory is yours to walk.

session_steps.title: List
session_steps.content: Three triggering situations from this week.

session_steps.title: Moment
session_steps.content: The exact moment of reaction in each.

session_steps.title: Demand
session_steps.content: What did the moment demand of you?

session_steps.title: Pattern
session_steps.content: Find the pattern across all three.

content.expected_experience: Triggers stop being random attacks and become readable signals — each pointing to an unowned part of the self.
content.safety_notes: Choose mild-to-moderate triggers. Deep trauma triggers belong with a therapist, not a solo practice.

short_description: Map your top triggers — the shadow's entry points.

content.objective: Map your top triggers — the shadow's entry points. (For Anxiety variation.)
instructions: List three situations that triggered you this week.
For each, name the exact moment of reaction.
Under each, write: what did this moment demand of me?
Look for the pattern across all three.
The pattern is the map; the territory is yours to walk.

content.expected_experience: Triggers stop being random attacks and become readable signals — each pointing to an unowned part of the self.
content.safety_notes: Choose mild-to-moderate triggers. Deep trauma triggers belong with a therapist, not a solo practice.

title: Projection Spotting
description: Catch projection in the act — seeing your own content on others.
short_description: Catch projection in the act — seeing your own content on oth

content.objective: Catch projection in the act — seeing your own content on others.
instructions: Notice a strong judgment of another person.
Pause. Ask: is this about them, or about me?
Feel the judgment's energy in your own body.
Consider: what in me is this judgment protecting?
Let the judgment soften into curiosity.

session_steps.title: Judgment
session_steps.content: Catch a strong judgment in the act.

session_steps.title: Pause
session_steps.content: About them, or about me?

session_steps.title: Body
session_steps.content: Feel the judgment's energy in the body.

session_steps.title: Protect
session_steps.content: What in me is this protecting?

content.expected_experience: Projection is the mind's most constant magic trick. Spotting it live is a watershed moment in self-knowledge.
content.safety_notes: Spotting projection is not about believing every judgment is self-hatred — sometimes people are simply wrong. The practice is the pause, not the conclusion.
